top_signals.title: Providing Capital to Tech Companies: Masters In Business with Ann Berry
top_signals.summary: Barry speaks with Ann Berry, founder and managing partner of Threadneedle. They discuss her path from Goldman Sachs M&A and private equity to running a hospitality services company through the pandemic. They also discuss Ann's early-stage bets on AI and deepfake detection, and surveying the expanding IPO landscape. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Braskem Owners Pull Funding Offer as Debt Talks Hit Snag
top_signals.summary: Talks between Brazil’s Braskem SA and its creditors regarding an out-of-court debt rework have soured, with shareholders taking a proposed capital injection key to a deal off the table if talks stand as they are, according to people familiar with the matter.
